name: Red Ridge
description: A ridge in the Tusk mountains whose villages are terrorized by murderous trolls.

timeline.summary: In Hormgart's tale, word of murderous trolls on the Red Ridge spreads and Arni's small band begins hunting them (flashback).
timeline.quote: word spread of a scourge of murderous trolls, terrorizing villages all along the Red Ridge
